questions.q: The Thing is a founding member of which team?
questions.why: Ben Grimm belongs to the original Fantastic Four team, which first appeared in 1961.

questions.q: What is the Thing's real name?
questions.why: Benjamin Jacob Grimm became the Thing after cosmic ray exposure.

questions.q: Which catchphrase is the Thing famous for?
questions.why: Ben's battle cry is 'It's clobberin' time!'

questions.q: On which street did Ben grow up on New York's Lower East Side?
questions.why: Ben grew up in poverty on Yancy Street, home of the gang that loves to pester him.

questions.q: What sport earned Ben a scholarship to Empire State University?
questions.why: Ben attended Empire State University on a football scholarship, where he met Reed Richards.

questions.q: What is Ben's love interest Alicia Masters by profession?
questions.why: Alicia Masters is a blind sculptor who becomes Ben's love.

questions.q: Who played the Thing in the 2005 film adaptation?
questions.why: Michael Chiklis played Ben in the 2005 film and its 2007 sequel.

questions.q: A story from which year revealed that Ben is Jewish?
questions.why: Ben's Jewish heritage was revealed in a 2002 story, about four decades after his creation.

questions.q: What was the name of Ben's late brother, a former leader of the street gang that torments him?
questions.why: Ben's late brother Daniel once led the Yancy Street Gang.

questions.q: How many issues did the Thing's first ongoing solo series, launched in 1983, run for?
questions.why: The Thing's solo series from 1983 to 1986 ran for 36 issues.
